current.title: Ghost Wala Ghar Jamai
current.logline: Priya ke ghar-jamai pati Rahul ko sab sirf 'laptop wala bekar' bulate hain. Lekin jab unke parivarik business par cyber attack hota hai, tab unhein pata chalta hai ki unka 'useless' pati hi duniya ka sabse bada hacker 'Ghost' hai.

characters.name: Rahul
characters.secret: Duniya ka sabse bada ethical hacker aur cybersecurity expert, 'Ghost' ke naam se jaana jaata hai.
characters.want: Priya aur uske parivaar se respect aur acceptance.

characters.name: Priya
characters.secret: Apne pati ko ek bekar, ambition-less aadmi samajhti hai, uski asli worth se anjaan.
characters.want: Apne parivaar ka business safal ho, social status aur ek 'safal' pati.

characters.name: Mr. Sharma
characters.role: Priya ke pita, business ka malik
characters.secret: Rahul ko sirf ek bojh maante hain, uski asli kshamataon se bilkul anjaan.
characters.want: Apne parivaar ke legacy business ko bachana.

characters.name: Aarav
characters.secret: Khud ko genius samajhta hai, lekin incompetent aur arrogant hai.
characters.want: Business par control, Rahul ko hamesha neecha dikhana.

arc: Part 1: Rahul apne laptop par code type kar raha tha. Family dinner par Priya us par chilla rahi thi, 'Kitna time waste karte ho, Rahul! Koi 'real job' dhoondho!' Aarav hasa, 'Apne gaming mein busy hoga, bhabhi!' Rahul ne bas apni muthi bheench li. Woh jaanta tha ki jis game ki yeh log baat kar rahe hain, wahi game duniya ke sabse bade networks ko hack karne ki capability rakhta hai. Agle hi pal uske laptop par ek email pop hua, subject line tha: 'Urgent: Ghost, we need you for Project Chimera – $5 Million contract.' Family uske paas se guzarte hue phir se hans padi, 'Dekho isse, abhi bhi laptop mein ghusa hai!'

Part 2: Agle din Mr. Sharma ka chehra pila pada tha. 'Hamara saara data corrupt ho gaya hai! Website down hai!' Aarav phone par chilla raha tha, 'Koi toh help karo!' Rahul ne chupchap unki baat suni, uski aankhon mein system ki kamzori saaf dikh rahi thi. Priya ne use ghoora, 'Rahul, tumhari toh koi help nahi kar sakte. Tum bas baitho!' Rahul ne apna phone uthaya, screen par 'US Homeland Security' flash ho raha tha. Ek aur call uske secret identity, 'Ghost,' ke liye. Usne call kaata, phir se chupchap baith gaya. Mr. Sharma ne sar pakad liya, 'Bas, ab hamara business khatam!' Rahul ke phone par phir ring hui, is baar ek international agency thi, 'Ghost, urgent response needed! Global cyber threat. Only you can handle this.'

Part 3: Office mein ek top-notch cybersecurity expert presentation de raha tha, 'Sir, yeh hack itna advanced hai ki iska solution milna mushkil hai.' Aarav us par chilla raha tha. Rahul ne dheere se kaha, 'Agar aap firewall configuration mein yeh change karein toh...' Aarav us par hasa, 'Oh look, hamare ghar-jamai ko bhi cybersecurity aati hai! Jao Rahul, tum apne games khelo!' Priya ne bhi usse jhidka, 'Rahul, please. Yeh mazak ka time nahi hai.' Shaam ko, Rahul apne kamre mein baitha tha, uske laptop par family business ka compromised network data dikh raha tha. Uska personal phone vibrate hua. Screen par ek message tha, 'Ghost, we need you on board for the Global Cyber Summit. Your expertise is critical.' Rahul ne ek lambi saans li, aur phir us laptop screen ki taraf dekha jahan uske gharwalon ka business tabaah ho raha tha.

Part 4: Raat ke do baje the. Rahul apne laptop par tezi se kuch type kar raha tha, uski ungliyan code par dance kar rahi thi. Family ko pata hi nahi tha ki unka 'bekar' ghar-jamai unke system ko theek kar raha hai. Agle din, Mr. Sharma ke phone par call aaya, 'Sir, hamari website suddenly online aa gayi hai, aur data bhi recover ho raha hai!' Aarav ne khushi se jhooth bola, 'Maine contact kiya tha ek unknown source ko!' Priya ne Rahul ko dekha jo chupchap baitha tha. Shaam ko phir Rahul apne laptop par code likh raha tha. Achanak Aarav darwaze par khada tha, 'Kya chal raha hai yahan? Tum itni der tak kya karte ho is laptop par?' Usne shaq se Rahul ki taraf dekha. Rahul ne jaldi se screen minimize kar di. Lekin Priya ne uski screen par kuch complex code ke flashes dekh liye the.

Part 5: Aarav subah Rahul ke kamre mein ghusa, 'Rahul, tumhari raatein sirf laptop par hi guzarti hain! Kya chupate ho?' Rahul ne shanti se kaha, 'Kuch nahi.' Priya bhi wahan thi. 'Rahul, batao kya chal raha hai? Tum kuch theek karne ki koshish kar rahe ho na?' Rahul ne ek pal socha, 'Haan. Thodi bahut coding aati hai, socha help kar doon.' Aarav hasa, 'Tum? Tumhein coding aati hai? Hahahaha! Hamare expert se toh kuch hua nahi, tum kya karoge!' Tabhi office se call aaya, 'Sir, hamara expert bhi haar gaya hai. Keh raha hai ki yeh system koi genius hi theek kar sakta hai.' Mr. Sharma ki aankhon mein aasu the. Rahul utha, aur server room ki taraf chal diya. Sab use hairani se dekh rahe the. 'Main try kar sakta hoon,' usne kaha. Priya ne uski taraf dekha, 'Rahul, yeh mazak nahi hai!'
current.soFar: Rahul, jise uski family (patni Priya, saala Aarav, sasur Mr. Sharma) 'laptop wala bekar ghar-jamai' maanti hai, darasal duniya ka sabse khunkhaar hacker 'Ghost' hai. Part 1 mein, family ke taanon ke beech Rahul ko 'Project Chimera' ke liye $5 Million ka contract offer hota hai, jabki uske ghar wale agle din hone wale cyber attack se anjaan hain. Part 2 mein, Mr. Sharma ka business ek bade cyber attack ka shikar ho jaata hai, unka saara data corrupt ho jaata hai aur website down ho jaati hai. Rahul chupchap unki pareshani dekhta hai aur system ki kamzori samajh jaata hai. Parivaar use ab bhi bekar samajhta hai aur use 'koi help nahi kar sakte' kehkar bitha deta hai. Isi beech, Rahul ko 'US Homeland Security' aur phir ek international agency se 'Ghost' ke liye urgent calls aate hain, jisme use ek 'Global Cyber Threat' se nipatne ke liye bulaya jaata hai, kehte hain 'Only you can handle this.'
current.cliffhanger: Rahul ne international agency ka call accept kiya, jisme use 'Ghost' ke naam se 'Global Cyber Threat' se nipatne ke liye bulaya jaa raha hai, jabki uski family use bekar samajh rahi hai aur unka business tabah ho raha hai.
